items.title: DEMUN: Fast and accurate discovery of music notation in very large collections
authors: Vojt\v{e}ch Dvo\v{r}\'ak, Filip B\'im, Ji\v{r}\'i Mayer, Martina Dvo\v{r}\'akov\'a, Mark\'eta Herzanov\'a Vlkov\'a, Pavel Pecina, Petr \v{Z}abi\v{c}ka, Jan Haji\v{c} jr
items.abstract: arXiv:2606.31956v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Much of written musical heritage is preserved and digitised at memory institutions: libraries, museums, and archives. Owing to their collection structures, sheet music tends to be concentrated in large subsets that are defined as collections of music, with corresponding metadata that makes the music findable.
